subject.title: improve: stream native sessions as hosts finish

question: Should `onHost` become the supported additive session-catalog provider API, with the aggregate list result retained as the required authoritative compatibility snapshot?
rationale: The implementation expands the plugin-facing list-provider contract and establishes observable timing and late-result semantics that cannot safely be inferred from one PR alone.

options.title: Approve the additive callback contract
options.body: Document `onHost` as an optional best-effort progressive hint while requiring the final host array as the authoritative result, then resolve the adoption race before merge.

options.title: Keep progress internal to core
options.body: Replace the provider callback with a core-owned mechanism if maintainers do not want progressive delivery exposed through the plugin SDK.

recommendation.title: Approve the additive callback contract
recommendation.body: Document `onHost` as an optional best-effort progressive hint while requiring the final host array as the authoritative result, then resolve the adoption race before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The proposed provider contract and its implementation are concentrated in this PR.
